reason: Primary purpose is an in-chat, workspace-local file editing plugin: it adds a slide-in Monaco editor + file tree panel for editing files directly in DSH Web. User-facing value is local file navigation and editing within the interface, with RPC-backed workspace read/write support and web UI panel injection; no explicit dangerous external integrations are indicated.

capabilities: Read workspace files via RPC endpoints
Write/overwrite workspace files via RPC endpoints
Provide a built-in Monaco-based file editor panel in-chat
Load editor dependencies from CDN at runtime

reasons.code: Plugin defines DSH client/web integration and injects UI into shell/sidebar slots to render an embedded editing panel.
Host-side RPC provides describe/listDir/readFile/writeFile channels backed by DSH filesystem service, enabling file-system operations.
Monaco Editor is loaded dynamically from CDN and used for editing experience.
